title: El taller de motos
goal: Describe a noise without knowing the word for it
culture: The workshop is half the pavement and he will look at it now, not on Tuesday. You do not need the vocabulary for the part — you need where it is and when it happens, and he does the rest.

beats.es: Buenas. ¿Qué le pasa a la moto?
beats.good: Hace un ruido is enough to start with. You do not need the word for the part and you are not expected to have it.
Where it comes from is worth more than what it sounds like. Put your hand on the place and say aquí atrás.
When it happens is the diagnosis. Cuando freno and aquí atrás together have already told him what it is.

beats.es: Ah, son las balatas. Se las cambio ahorita.
beats.good: ¿Es grave? works for a moto, a tooth and a relative. Ask it and you get a straight answer, because he wants the work either way and there is plenty of it.
